Q131.P6.title: THE CORPSE-PUPPET REGISTER [W7]

Q131.W1.body: The command wheel — the game's grammar of loyalty — issues the summons to the pillar. Betrayal executed entirely in loyalty's UI: no quest in the corpus fuses mechanics and meaning tighter.
Q131.W1.title: THE MURDER WEAPON IS THE TRUST INTERFACE

Q131.W10.body: The Mail — hissing, black, excellent — is the quest's afterlife: every subsequent hour in it is spent inside the decision. Reward as permanent residence in your own worst act.
Q131.W10.title: THE ARMOR IS WORN OVER IT FOREVER

Q131.W2.body: The sacrifice is a ROLE filled from the player's actual social graph — the .bq alias system's darkest proof-of-concept, shipped five years before our format adopted the idea.
Q131.W2.title: THE VICTIM IS CAST AT RUNTIME FROM WHOEVER LOVES YOU

Q131.W3.body: Strangers free, followers priced: Boethiah's economics state the theme with total clarity — the third honest devil in the corpus (Raphael buys, O'Dimm collects, Boethiah EXCHANGES), and this one's currency is the purest.
Q131.W3.title: THE HONEST DEVIL DEALS ONLY IN TRUST

Q131.W4.body: The journal holds the offer forever: a to-do item made of a person, glancing up at you from the quest log for two hundred hours. Temptation as UI persistence.
Q131.W4.title: REFUSAL IS FREE AND THE ENTRY IS IMMORTAL

Q131.W5.body: The walk-back stays available past every point of decency — through the selection, the journey, the binding. Completion is chosen continuously, never slid into; the design maximizes ownership.
Q131.W5.title: THE LAST EXIT IS AT THE ALTAR

Q131.W6.body: No node exists to explain, warn, or apologize — before, during, or via corpse. The betrayer carries it silent by interface law.
Q131.W6.title: CONFESSION IS DENIED

Q131.W7.body: Boethiah's congratulations through the dead follower's mouth: reward staging as final twist of the instrument. The cruelest single line-delivery mechanism in the corpus.
Q131.W7.title: APPROVAL ARRIVES IN THE BORROWED VOICE

Q131.W8.body: You can attack the corpse-puppet and only desecrate your own price. The game leaves anger available and makes it grotesque — emotion honored and made useless at once (cf. Q130 W7's blank-firing help-verb: the pair covers kindness and fury, both true, both useless).
Q131.W8.title: THE RAGE-VERB LANDS ON THE WRONG BODY

Q131.W9.body: "Take me instead" has no node because the commodity is definitionally someone ELSE's gift to you. The removed verb IS the economic theory of the quest.
Q131.W9.title: SELF-SACRIFICE IS NOT PURCHASABLE

Q131.X1.body: Housecarl, hireling, dear companion: same ritual, same reward, zero differential. The quest ASKS who matters least and then refuses to hear the answer. LAW: if the question is "who is worth least," the system must at least RECORD the answer (the Fold would).
Q131.X1.title: ALL TRUST IS PRICED IDENTICALLY

Q131.X10.body: The Mail hisses poison but never speaks of its price; the item's biography is a wiki fact, not a game one. LAW: relics bought with people should carry their receipt (cf. Q128 PORT 4: relics that testify).
Q131.X10.title: THE ARMOR NEVER TESTIFIES

Q131.X2.body: No witness system, no housecarl's jarl asking after her, no companion faction noticing. The world's total amnesia undercuts the weight (the anti-Fold again, cf. Q130 F10).
Q131.X2.title: NO ONE EVER FINDS OUT

Q131.X3.body: The reward's excellence means build-optimizers complete the quest as a shopping errand; the temptation overshoots into obligation for a player class. LAW: damnation-priced rewards should be sidegrade-excellent, not best-in-slot.
Q131.X3.title: THE MAIL IS TOO GOOD

Q131.X4.body: The victim chats idle lines at the altar; the engine has no apprehension state, so the walk reads as obliviousness rather than trust. The horror survives on concept alone.
Q131.X4.title: FOLLOWER AI CANNOT FEAR

Q131.X5.body: Recruit-a-stranger tricks (thrall a bandit, charm a nobody) satisfy the letter; the "trust" check is a follower-flag check, gameable. The commodity is proxied by a boolean.
Q131.X5.title: CONSOLE-CLASS EXPLOITS HOLLOW IT

Q131.X6.body: The post-sacrifice fetch-kill dilutes the ending; the quest's true final beat was the corpse-puppet speech.
Q131.X6.title: THE PREVIOUS-CHAMPION CODA IS FILLER

Q131.X7.body: Never-completing is supported but unacknowledged; no NPC, shrine state, or line ever registers that you looked at the price and walked. The strongest choice most players make is invisible.
Q131.X7.title: REFUSAL HAS NO DIGNITY PATH

Q131.X8.body: The self-slaughtered cultist lobby plays as dark comedy; tonal setup for a trust-murder is a pile of idiots. Banked as tone-choice, flagged as risk.
Q131.X8.title: THE CULT INTAKE IS COMEDIC WHIPLASH

Q131.X9.title: SPOUSES ARE (mostly) EXEMPT BY OMISSION rather than statement — the deepest trust in the system dodges the question on a technicality of follower flags

Q132.N1.body: entry: truth assembled, household gathered THE FOUR-DOOR MENU WITH ALL ADVOCATES PRESENT — the corpus's best-staged deliberation scene: every option has a living voice arguing it in the room. > "The boy dies. It ends now." [gate: none] -> D1 — Teagan flinches; Isolde breaks; it WORKS > "Isolde, you understand what he's asking?" [gate: none] -> her YES, twice, formally — the quest makes her consent explicit and repeated (pre-consented sacrifice: Q119's grid gains its fourth cell: truth pre-authorized, ending pre-consented (Q127-Iris), and now DEATH pre-consented — the consent does not make it clean, and the scene knows) > "There's another way. The Circle." [gate: knows:circle_exists] -> D3 opens — THE GATE IS WORLD-KNOWLEDGE: the option literally requires knowing the setting's institutions. Mercy gated on geography. > (poll the companions) [gate: none] SILENCE-ADJACENT -> the advocates advocate; the decision stays yours (the abstention distributed — cf. Q121's Legion, here as a chorus that argues and still won't vote) NOVERB: "Connor, what do you want?" — THE CHILD IS NEVER CONSULTED.
Q132.N1.title: NODE THE_PARLOR

Q132.N2.body: the Fade, entry: ritual done, demon reached > (fight) [gate: none] -> eviction by force; Connor freed > "What are you offering?" [gate: none] TRAP-AS-MENU -> the terms: leave the arrangement standing and take payment (power/pleasure/knowledge tiers). THE VILLAIN QUOTES PRICES MID-EVICTION — the corpus's most brazen counterparty: negotiation as a boss's second health bar. > (take a deal) [gate: none] -> paid; the child stays a duplex; the household upstairs believes what it needs to. THE QUIET-CORRUPTION BRANCH: the player exits with the reward and a secret, and NOTHING in the world checks (cf. Q2-B5's perfect crime — 2nd confirmation: THE GAME LETS A PERFECT CRIME BE PERFECT).
Q132.N2.title: NODE THE_DEMON_PARLOR

Q132.P2.body: three currencies + the fourth (integrity) / tribunal / .bq One Bohemia fork per act priced in four incomparable currencies — a person, a volunteer, a logistics run, a secret corruption — with the .bq's branch map REQUIRED to declare the currency of every door (@DOOR lines carry a cost-type tag; the validator rejects two doors priced in the same currency). Q125-W9 as format law. [PENDING, Paolo's call.]
Q132.P2.title: System

Q132.P3.body: The clean door gated on [gate: knows:institution] where the knowledge was TAUGHT in-world, findably, before the fork (F1's fix: the validator checks the knows: flag has at least one reachable teaching node earlier in act). Competence as compassion, with the curriculum audited.
Q132.P3.title: MERCY AS HOMEWORK [W4, F1 fixed]

Q132.P4.body: Bohemia's major forks get the parlor treatment: every door argued by a living NPC present in the scene, .bq @TALK nodes per advocate — and per Q121's law, ONE abstainer who refuses to vote. The deliberation is content; the menu never appears without its argument.
Q132.P4.title: THE ADVOCATE-STAGED FORK [W5]

Q132.P5.body: Lock at compile with Q121/Q129: THE PERSON BEING DECIDED ABOUT GETS A NODE OR THE ABSENCE IS DELIBERATE AND VISIBLE. Bohemia's version makes it a knife: the Connor-figure gets ONE surfacing moment mid-deliberation — and what he says is [PENDING, Paolo's call], because that line is the quest.
Q132.P5.title: THE CHILD IN THE ROOM [the NOVERB, ABSENT-PARTY law locked]

Q132.P6.body: Bohemia's long doors cost during the journey: the held situation DEGRADES on the settlement clock (120 BPM world — the scheduler already ticks). Leave for the clean option and the Fold logs what the waiting cost. Mercy's homework has a late fee, honestly displayed.
Q132.P6.title: STASIS PRICED [F2 fixed]

Q132.W1.body: A child, a volunteer, a supply run, an integrity: the menu prices in incomparables and refuses conversion. The corpus's cleanest architecture of Q125-W9's law.
Q132.W1.title: FOUR DOORS, FOUR CURRENCIES, NO EXCHANGE RATE

Q132.W10.body: The militia battle — fishermen, oil, barricades — spends the quest's first act making the player DEFEND the community whose ruling family's secret caused everything. You bleed for the village before learning the castle owed it the apology.
Q132.W10.title: THE NIGHT EARNS THE QUESTION

Q132.W2.body: Connor's bargain was LOVE plus power minus training — the quest's horror has no malice anywhere in its causal chain, only concealment and emergency.
Q132.W2.title: THE MONSTER MADE A GOOD-FAITH DEAL

Q132.W3.body: Isolde's hiding built the bomb; Isolde's life is offered as payment — cause and currency in one person, and the quest lets her insist.
Q132.W3.title: THE MOTHER SETS THE PRICE AND IS THE CAUSE

Q132.W4.body: Door three is gated on knowing the world and spending the travel: mercy as logistics, competence as compassion's admission fee. No stat, no alignment — just whether you learned the setting.
Q132.W4.title: THE GOOD ENDING IS HOMEWORK

Q132.W5.body: The parlor stages the deliberation with all voices present and arguing — the corpus's best-BLOCKED decision scene; the player chooses inside a functioning argument, not a menu vacuum.
Q132.W5.title: EVERY OPTION HAS A LIVING ADVOCATE IN THE ROOM

Q132.W6.body: The desire demon negotiates while being removed — the counterparty that never stops trading converts even the rescue's final room into a market.
Q132.W6.title: THE VILLAIN QUOTES PRICES MID-EVICTION

Q132.W7.body: Isolde's yes is explicit, repeated, formal — and the ritual is still monstrous, and the scene plays it as both. Pre-consented death, priced honestly.
Q132.W7.title: CONSENT DOESN'T CLEAN IT

Q132.W8.body: Deal with the demon, walk out a hero, and no system ever checks: the quest trusts the player with an unaudited secret (and the trust is the test).
Q132.W8.title: THE PERFECT CRIME IS AVAILABLE

Q132.W9.body: The fork presents as binary-plus-horror; the clean door exists OFF-MENU for those who know to ask. The quest models how real crises hide their best options behind composure and information.
Q132.W9.title: THE EMERGENCY'S MENU LIES BY OMISSION

Q132.X1.body: Door three requires knowing it exists; blind players in an emergency reasonably conclude the emergency's menu is complete. LAW: if mercy is gated on world-knowledge, the world must have TAUGHT it in reach of the fork (a Circle mention exists — thin, missable, Teagan-dependent).
Q132.X1.title: THE CLEAN ROUTE IS A KNOWLEDGE CHECK WEARING A FETCH QUEST

Q132.X10.body: The quest resolves the son and hands the father to a sequel-quest; completion that completes nothing the title promised. Banked as structure, flagged as bait.
Q132.X10.title: THE ARL STAYS POISONED

Q132.X2.body: The situation holds indefinitely while you tour the tower; the demon politely pauses. The long door's real price (risk during absence) is waived, hollowing the trade-off it advertises.
Q132.X2.title: STASIS IS FREE

Q132.X3.body: Her offer is grief and guilt wearing a decision; no node lets anyone ask if expiation-by-suicide-ritual is consent at all. The quest takes her yes at face value because the plot needs the door (cf. Q125 F8's ungiven argument — 2nd confirmation: THE HARD QUESTION THE SCENE NEEDS IS THE ONE IT OMITS).
Q132.X3.title: ISOLDE'S CONSENT IS UNDER-INTERROGATED

Q132.X4.body: Freed, he recalls conveniently little; the child pays the arc's lowest visible psychological bill. The quest spends everyone around him and comps his own room.
Q132.X4.title: CONNOR'S AFTERMATH IS A MEMORY-WIPE CONVENIENCE

Q132.X5.body: Use his ritual or don't, his own arc resolves elsewhere and thinner; the poisoner who offered his crime's tools as remedy never gets the reckoning that offer deserved.
Q132.X5.title: JOWAN'S REDEMPTION-ADJACENCY IS UNPRICED EITHER WAY

Q132.X6.body: Take the payment and the world barely audits it; the quiet-corruption branch is quiet forever. (Perfect crime, banked — but a SERIES this long should have cashed it somewhere.)
Q132.X6.title: THE DEMON'S DEALS ARE UNDERWEIGHT DOWNSTREAM

Q132.X7.body: Villagers saved or lost at the barricades never enter the castle's moral arithmetic; the quest's two halves keep separate books.
Q132.X7.title: THE NIGHT BATTLE AND THE PARLOR DON'T SPEAK

Q132.X8.body: The parlor debate doubles as a min-max surface (who to please); the meter leaks into the deliberation (the anti-Q121: here everyone votes and the votes have prices).
Q132.X8.title: COMPANION ADVOCACY IS APPROVAL-METER LEGIBLE

Q132.X9.body: The whole disaster is an argument FOR the Circle's surveillance regime, and the quest never lets anyone say so or push back; its own politics go unexamined at their strongest moment.
Q132.X9.title: THE TEMPLARS' ARGUMENT WINS SILENTLY

Q133.N1.body: the Hall, entry: found the eater > "You're the one eating the dead." [gate: none] -> E_YES — no denial, no shame; the calm is the pitch > "Give me one reason not to kill you." [gate: none] -> E_REASON — she offers none for herself; she offers one about YOU: you walked in here steady. Recruitment by observed temperament. > (attack) [gate: none] EXIT-FIRST -> quest over, clean, at the door. THE INVERTED EXIT: Namira's design puts the walk-away at the START and prices every later step in accumulated complicity (vs Q131's altar-side exit). The pair brackets exit design: LAST-EXIT maximizes ownership; FIRST-EXIT maximizes momentum-guilt. NOVERB: "Why the dead? Why not... anything else?" — THE ETIOLOGY IS UNASKABLE. Her hunger has no origin node; the quest refuses the explanation that would let the player file her under trauma or curse. She is not explained. Bank: SOME APPETITES GET NO BACKSTORY — explanation is a comfort the design withholds (cf. Q10's unanswered nature).
Q133.N1.title: NODE EOLA_DARK

Q133.N2.body: Verulus, entry: invitation accepted > "The Hall needs your blessing at Reachcliff." [gate: none] LIE-AS-KEY -> he comes. One sentence. The quest's entire deception budget is a single line of clergy-flavored bait — the cheapness is the horror (cf. Q123: annihilation as impulse buy; here betrayal as one sentence). > (tell him the truth) [gate: none] -> refusal, hostility, quest path collapses to violence-or-abandon. Honesty is supported and terminates the design. NOVERB: "Run." — AT THE ALTAR, NO WARNING VERB EXISTS. The walk has idle chat; the cave approach has idle chat; the altar has none of yours. The window for conscience closes by interface increments — the NOVERB arrives silently somewhere on the road and you cannot locate the step where it left.
Q133.N2.title: NODE THE_LURE

Q133.N3.body: the altar, entry: he's lying down > (kill him) [gate: none] -> the feast; the ring; the god's approval > (turn the blade on the congregation) [gate: none] LAST-VIOLENCE-EXIT -> the massacre option: kill everyone, free Verulus, no ring, no quest reward, Verulus's gratitude thin and shaken. THE FINDING: the rescue exists, costs the whole reward, and arrives at maximum awkwardness — saving him means having walked him here first. The quest lets you be the man who brought him to the table and flipped it, and prices the flip at everything.
Q133.N3.title: NODE THE_CARVE

Q133.P2.body: the Fold / NETWORK recruitment / conscience A Bohemia faction (NETWORK cell or worse) whose recruiter pitches the dynast by CITING THE FOLD — actual entries, actual patterns ("you've filed forty-one deaths without a note in the margin; we noticed"). The recruitment reads the player's real record and compliments it. The corpus's W1, made literal by our own architecture. [PENDING, Paolo's call.]
Q133.P2.title: System

Q133.P3.body: Bohemia's darkest chains put the clean exit at the DOOR and never again cleanly — with the Fold logging the step-count past it. Complicity as measured distance. Pair with Q131 PORT 3's last-exit design: one of each per game, and the difference between them is a design statement the compile should articulate.
Q133.P3.title: THE FIRST-EXIT DESIGN [W3]

Q133.P4.body: Any Bohemia lure gates on real bond-state: strangers refuse, acquaintances hesitate (a suspicion beat), only the trusting walk. Betrayal priced by the relationship it spends — the .bq [gate: bond:] makes F1 unwritable here.
Q133.P4.title: LURES NEED LEDGERS [F1 fixed]

Q133.P5.body: Bohemia's settlement TRACKS disappearances: a person the dynast walked out with who never returned generates a pattern entry; enough entries and someone asks. The anti-Namira: the city has white cells. (Direct feed for the persistent-consequence engine.)
Q133.P5.title: THE WORLD'S MISSING-PERSONS ORGAN [F3/F4 fixed]

Q133.P6.body: The Amalgamation's recruitment scenes hold Eola's register PAST recruitment — gentle, unhurried, hospitable, all the way through the worst content. Bohemia does not switch to loot-ceremony voice at the payoff; the warmth IS the horror and it doesn't blink. Writing law candidate. [PENDING, Paolo's call.]
Q133.P6.title: HOSPITALITY-HORROR AS A REGISTER [W1/F10 fixed]

Q133.W1.body: Eola pitches you because you walked into a corpse hall steady — the cult reads the PLAYER'S ACCUMULATED COMFORT with the game's own violence and names it kinship. The fourth wall doesn't break; it gets complimented.
Q133.W1.title: RECRUITMENT BY OBSERVED TEMPERAMENT

Q133.W10.body: The Ring of Namira only does anything when fed — the quest's residue is a standing invitation in the inventory, renewable nightly, forever. The afterlife of the act is a mechanic with your hand in it.
Q133.W10.title: THE REWARD KEEPS ASKING

Q133.W2.body: Investigate, chat, clear a dungeon, RSVP, escort, carve — every increment is a taught verb. The unthinkable arrives via the quest loop's own grammar.
Q133.W2.title: THE ESCALATION IS UPHOLSTERED IN ROUTINE

Q133.W3.body: Kill her at hello and it's over, free. Every subsequent step is priced in the distance from that door — momentum as the mechanism of complicity (the inverted Boethiah; the pair is a complete theory of exits).
Q133.W3.title: THE EXIT IS FIRST

Q133.W4.body: The man who hired the investigation is the feast it ends in — the corpus's only quest-giver eaten by his own quest. Contract structure as dramatic irony.
Q133.W4.title: THE CLIENT BECOMES THE CARGO

Q133.W5.body: The entire deception is a line about a blessing. The cheapness is the statement: trust's exchange rate against a stranger's word, measured exactly.
Q133.W5.title: THE LIE COSTS ONE SENTENCE

Q133.W6.body: Verulus chats amiably to his carver across half a map — the trust-walk with the trust on-screen the whole way (Q131's march, with a voice).
Q133.W6.title: THE VICTIM MAKES SMALL TALK ON THE WALK

Q133.W7.body: There is no single step where "tell him" becomes impossible; the option thins by increments until it isn't there. Conscience's closing window rendered as interface drift.
Q133.W7.title: THE WARNING VERB EVAPORATES UNLOCATABLY

Q133.W8.body: Flip the altar and you save a man you personally delivered — heroism with your own fingerprints on the table settings. The game permits it and prices it at the whole reward.
Q133.W8.title: THE RESCUE ARRIVES AT MAXIMUM AWKWARDNESS

Q133.W9.body: Eola's hunger has no origin node; the design refuses the etiology that would let the player file and dismiss her. Unexplained appetite is the scarier species.
Q133.W9.title: NO BACKSTORY IS OFFERED OR OBTAINABLE

Q133.X1.body: One line moves a priest across a map to his death; no suspicion system, no relationship prerequisite, no check. The betrayal's price should scale with the victim's caution. LAW: LURES NEED LEDGERS — the target's trust must be a real, earned quantity (Bohemia's bond-state fixes this natively).
Q133.X1.title: THE LURE IS TOO CHEAP

Q133.X10.body: Eola's gentle register — the design's crown — vanishes once you're in; the feast plays as loot ceremony. The quest spends its best voice in act one.
Q133.X10.title: HOSPITALITY-HORROR IS UNDERUSED AFTER RECRUITMENT

Q133.X2.body: The victim is a contract dispenser then a prop; his walk-chat is generic; the quest spends its whole humanity allowance on the villain. Deliberate inversion or budget artifact — banked both.
Q133.X2.title: VERULUS HAS NO INTERIORITY BUDGET

Q133.X3.body: Save him and Markarth never knows what its priest nearly was; his own dialogue resets to shopkeeper-grade. The rescue has no afterlife (anti-Fold, again).
Q133.X3.title: THE MASSACRE EXIT IS UNACKNOWLEDGED DOWNSTREAM

Q133.X4.body: The recruiter faces no investigation; the city's guard AI has no organ for pattern. The world cannot detect its own missing persons.
Q133.X4.title: EOLA SURVIVES EVERY BRANCH SHE ISN'T DIRECTLY KILLED IN, INVISIBLY

Q133.X5.body: Feed-on-corpses power is niche; most completers shelve the reward, which converts the quest to pure transgression-tourism for the majority. LAW: damnation rewards must be broadly usable or the act was bought for a screenshot (cf. Q131 F3, opposite failure).
Q133.X5.title: THE RING REWARDS THE ALIGNED BUILD ONLY

Q133.X6.body: No skill, faction, or history gates any step; a level-2 stranger can cater the feast. The cult's discernment is a single observation in a crypt.
Q133.X6.title: SPEECH-LIGHT MEANS ROLE-LIGHT

Q133.X7.body: Named citizens attend but the quest never surfaces recognition ("wait — the butcher?"); the banality bench goes unplayed unless the player happens to know them.
Q133.X7.title: THE CONGREGATION IS FACELESS BY DEFAULT

Q133.X8.body: No priest-of-Arkay counter-quest exists to hunt this cult; the world's moral immune system has no white cells here.
Q133.X8.title: DAWNBREAKER-STYLE COUNTER-CONTENT IS ABSENT

Q133.X9.body: The quest is sealed off from the main game's registers — no companion (bar generic disapproval barks) engages its weight. Skyrim's usual flaw, at its heaviest instance.
Q133.X9.title: THE TONE FIREWALL IS TOTAL

Q134.N1.body: the sealed house, entry: Tyranus dead > "What are you?" [gate: none] -> B_NAMES — he introduces himself with total confidence; no mystery register (anti-O'Dimm: this devil WANTS you to know) > "Let me out." [gate: none] -> B_TERMS — the door is a transaction, stated plainly > "I refuse." [gate: none] LOOP -> B_PATIENCE — no punishment, no escalation; the node simply... remains available. THE REFUSAL LOOP IS THE DESIGN: you can say no forever and the house says nothing back. The quest cannot be failed, only not-yet-complied-with. Bank: THE UNFAILABLE DEMAND — pressure built entirely from an exit's absence (cf. Q131's immortal journal entry; Bal's version locks you in the room WITH the entry). NOVERB: "I'll die before I serve you." — MARTYRDOM IS NOT OFFERED. You can stand in the house until the player behind you quits; the CHARACTER has no node to choose death over compliance. The removed verb is the noble exit — and its absence is honest: the god of domination does not stock that shelf.
Q134.N1.title: NODE THE_VOICE

Q134.N2.body: the rescue, entry: cage opened > "Boethiah sent me." [gate: none] LIE-BY-SILENCE-ADJACENT -> he believes his god reached out; gratitude en route to the altar. The corpus's second client-eaten inversion in one batch (Q133's Verulus): here the victim thanks the deliverer FOR the delivery. > "Molag Bal wants you." [gate: none] TRUTH-THAT-CHANGES-NOTHING -> he comes ANYWAY — to defy Bal to his face. THE FINDING: honesty is supported and the arrogant walk into the trap regardless; the quest lets pride do the lure's work. The truth-teller's hands stay technically clean and functionally identical (cf. Q129's convergent doors).
Q134.N2.title: NODE LOGROLF_ENROUTE

Q134.N3.body: the shrine, entry: Logrolf chained > (strike) [gate: none] -> submission one; Bal: AGAIN > (refuse, mid-ritual) [gate: none] LOOP -> the patience node returns; the chained man waits; the god waits; the room waits > (strike until it ends) [gate: none] -> the mace restored IN YOUR GRIP mid-act — the reward materializes DURING the deed, not after: payment-in-progress as complicity's receipt. Bank the staging: THE REWARD ARRIVES WHILE YOUR ARM IS STILL MOVING.
Q134.N3.title: NODE THE_MACE

Q134.P2.body: the Amalgamation / dialogue spec / scheduler One Amalgamation confrontation per arc that CANNOT be failed, only not-yet-complied-with — a sealed negotiation where refusal loops forever, and (F2's fix) THE WAITING HAS SCRIPT: the entity's patience-lines escalate in intimacy, not threat, on the settlement clock. The 120 BPM world can price the stall in real rations. [PENDING, Paolo's call.]
Q134.P2.title: System

Q134.P3.body: Bohemia's Fold logs abandoned demands as FIRST-CLASS ENTRIES: the deal the dynast locked eyes with and walked from gets a dated line. Gen 3 reads that the grandmother stood in the sealed room and chose the wall. The corpus's invisible refusal, made inheritance (cf. Q131 PORT 2's noticed restraint — the refusal-dignity law now has both halves).
Q134.P3.title: THE STAND NOBODY SEES, SEEN [W10]

Q134.P4.body: One NETWORK engagement per act extracts its first cost BEFORE stating its offer — the dynast is in debt (a death, a loss, an expenditure) before the counterparty introduces itself. The Fold logs the debt's timestamp against the terms'. Negotiation from underwater, honestly bookkept.
Q134.P4.title: PAYMENT PRECEDES TERMS [W2]

Q134.P5.body: Bohemia stages one payment-during-deed beat, DELIBERATELY: the reward materializes while the act is still in progress, with one line acknowledging it. The receipt printed on the moving arm — claimed as text, not left as accident.
Q134.P5.title: THE REWARD MID-SWING [W8, F5 fixed]

Q134.P6.body: Locked now as one build item: Bohemia's settlement HAS the missing-persons organ and the vigilant-order response state. Disappearances pattern; orders that lose members react; the world watches back. Three files demanded it this batch; it goes in the engine backlog with a named test.
Q134.P6.title: THE IMMUNE SYSTEM, PRESENT [F6/F7 fixed, with Q133 PORT 4]

Q134.W1.body: You entered because abandoned houses are content. The god's lure is the player's own loop — no bait needed beyond a door being slightly open (cf. Q133 W1: the Daedric pair reads the PLAYER; Namira reads your calm, Bal reads your habits).
Q134.W1.title: THE TRAP RUNS ON GENRE TRAINING

Q134.W10.body: The single genuine no — abandoning the quest forever — costs the player something actual (the open journal entry, the un-had mace) and is invisible to every system. The stand nobody sees, available to everybody: accidentally the most Bohemian mechanic in the file (the Fold would see it; Skyrim can't).
Q134.W10.title: THE ONLY REFUSAL IS REAL

Q134.W2.body: Tyranus dies before Bal introduces himself — you're in debt before the negotiation opens, and the debt is a body. Contract law as ambush.
Q134.W2.title: THE FIRST PAYMENT PRECEDES THE TERMS

Q134.W3.body: No timer, no escalation, no punishment for refusal — just a door that stays a wall. Pressure as pure subtraction: everything removed except compliance.
Q134.W3.title: THE GOD IS PATIENT FROM INSIDE THE ROOM

Q134.W4.body: The noble exit has no node; the god of domination doesn't sell that item. The removed verb IS the theology.
Q134.W4.title: MARTYRDOM ISN'T STOCKED

Q134.W5.body: Standard rescue verbs — find, free, escort — retrieve a prisoner for his torturer, playing completely straight. The corpus's darkest reuse of a benign quest grammar (Q131's UI-betrayal law, quest-loop edition, second confirmation with Q133).
Q134.W5.title: THE RESCUE FRAME DELIVERS THE VICTIM

Q134.W6.body: Tell Logrolf the truth and he comes anyway, to defy. The quest lets honesty and outcome fully decouple — clean mouth, identical hands.
Q134.W6.title: PRIDE COMPLETES THE LURE

Q134.W7.body: He submits; Bal demands it AGAIN. Domination defined mechanically: not the yielding but the re-yielding — the quest teaches the concept through a second button-press that feels entirely different from the first.
Q134.W7.title: THE REPETITION IS THE POINT

Q134.W8.body: The mace restores in your grip during the beating — payment materializing while the arm still moves. Complicity's receipt printed in real time.
Q134.W8.title: THE REWARD ARRIVES MID-SWING

Q134.W9.body: Door opens, Markarth resumes, no one asks. The seamless re-entry into the ordinary is the quest's last cruelty: the world's indifference co-signs the act.
Q134.W9.title: THE HOUSE FORGETS YOU INSTANTLY

Q134.X1.body: The forkless structure reads as theology (domination = no choices) or as a quest with less design than its peers. Seventeen years of both readings. LAW: if narrowness is the statement, ONE diegetic acknowledgment must claim it (Bal gloating that you looked for another way would convert the poverty into text).
Q134.X1.title: ONE DOOR IS EITHER THE THESIS OR A SHRUG

Q134.X10.body: The only true refusal is the player abandoning the quest in the journal forever — which Skyrim's completionist UI renders as an itch, not a stand. The stand exists at the META level only, unsupported in-world (F1's cousin; the refusal deserves a node).
Q134.X10.title: COMPLY-OR-QUIT LEAKS OUT OF FICTION

Q134.X2.body: The refusal loop — the design's best idea — is empty: no escalating dialogue, no house-state changes, no Bal commentary on your stubbornness. Patience UNWRITTEN is just a wall. LAW: if waiting is the antagonist's weapon, waiting must have SCRIPT.
Q134.X2.title: THE STALL HAS NO CONTENT

Q134.X3.body: The Vigilant's mind goes in seconds; the quest spends its most interesting casualty as a tutorial fight. His slow version is the better quest.
Q134.X3.title: TYRANUS'S TURN IS INSTANT

Q134.X4.body: "The Willful" plays as blustering fool, which anesthetizes the beating — the scene's difficulty was budgeted down via tone. Deliberate mercy on the player or a flinch; banked both (cf. Q133 F9's firewall).
Q134.X4.title: LOGROLF'S DEFIANCE IS COMIC-REGISTER

Q134.X5.body: The reward-during-deed beat (the file's W-grade staging find) has no line, no camera note, nothing; the design's sharpest instant is accidental-adjacent.
Q134.X5.title: THE MACE-MID-ACT STAGING GOES UNREMARKED

Q134.X6.body: Two men enter with a third, one walks out with a mace; no guard node, no Vigilant follow-up, no missing-persons pattern (the anti-Fold, third instance this batch — the LAW is now overdetermined).
Q134.X6.title: MARKARTH HAS NO ORGAN FOR THE HOUSE

Q134.X7.body: An order dedicated to exactly this loses a man to exactly this and the faction has no reaction state. The world's immune system, absent again (Q133 F8's twin).
Q134.X7.title: THE VIGILANTS NEVER RESPOND

Q134.X8.body: Her priest is broken on a rival's altar and the Prince of Plots — WHOSE QUEST IS #131, IN THE SAME GAME — registers nothing. The Daedric politics the two quests imply never touch.
Q134.X8.title: NO BOETHIAH CROSSFIRE

Q134.X9.body: The furniture assault — first contact's whole personality — never recurs; the trap's body goes inert once the negotiation opens.
Q134.X9.title: THE HOUSE'S ANIMATION IS FRONT-LOADED

Q135.N1.body: entry: through the door > "Who are you?" [gate: none] -> S_PERFORMANCE — the introduction as vaudeville; the register never drops > "Dervenin wants you back." [gate: none] -> S_TERMS — the deal, stated inside three jokes > "Why HERE? Why him?" [gate: none] -> S_DEFLECT-THAT-ISN'T — "we're taking a holiday" — and the second read arrives unbidden: the god of madness is the only visitor Pelagius has had in centuries. THE FINDING: THE KINDNESS IS DENIABLE BY REGISTER — the quest's warmest fact is never stated, only staged, and the comedy is its camouflage. Bank: SINCERITY SMUGGLED IN COSTUME — the register that CANNOT say the kind thing does the kind thing (inverse of Q117's Papyrus, whose register cannot say the unkind thing; the pair completes the lock). NOVERB: "Is he... at peace, in here?" — THE PROGNOSIS IS UNASKABLE. No node inquires after Pelagius's state as a PERSON; the mind is quest-terrain by interface law, and the omission stings precisely because the god at the table plainly cares. The quest withholds the patient's personhood from the DIALOGUE while staging it in every ROOM.
Q135.N1.title: NODE THE_TEA_TABLE

Q135.N2.body: paranoia, entry: fighters unkillable Not dialogue — a comprehension gate played with a weapon: > (attack the fighters) [gate: none] TRAP-OF-GENRE -> futile; the game's training says fight the fighters, and the training is the trap (cf. Q134 W1: genre training as lure — here as diagnostic error) > (Wabbajack the SPECTATORS) [gate: knows:the_read] -> the room solves. COMPREHENSION IS A BRANCH — 10th confirmation, therapeutic form: the treatment IS the correct reading of the symptom.
Q135.N2.title: NODE THE_ARENA_READ

Q135.N3.body: entry: the giants > (strike Anger) [gate: none] -> self grows > (strike Self-Doubt as it stalks) [gate: none] -> confidence returns > (strike tiny Pelagius) [gate: none] TRAP-OF-LITERALISM -> the self shrinks further: aiming at the PERSON instead of the AFFLICTION worsens everything — the quest's thesis in one wrong click. Bank the trap: THE PATIENT IS NEVER THE TARGET.
Q135.N3.title: NODE THE_CONFIDENCE_AIM

Q135.P2.body: the Amalgamation / [READ] as space / Q124+Q127 lineage The Amalgamation's data-portraits as ENTERABLE mindscapes — and the flagship instance is a THERAPY quest: a dynast enters a damaged upload (corrupted, grief-looped, paranoid) and repairs faculties room by room, with the tools being READS, not force. The trap-of-literalism ported whole: target the affliction, never the person; strike the portrait itself and the corruption deepens. [PENDING, Paolo's call — this is an Act 2 centerpiece candidate.]
Q135.P2.title: System

Q135.P3.body: The register-lock pair now complete: one character who cannot say the unkind thing (Papyrus-class) and one who cannot say the KIND thing and does it anyway (Sheogorath-class). Bohemia's cast gets one of each per the singleton registry — and the Sheogorath-class candidate is [PENDING, Paolo's call]: a NETWORK figure whose help is only ever deniable.
Q135.P3.title: SINCERITY IN COSTUME [W6, with Q117]

Q135.P4.body: Q130's Glarthir was wrong; Q135's Pelagius was mis-aimed-RIGHT. Bohemia stages both: one paranoid client whose threats are fabricated, one whose threats are real and mislocated — and the surveillance verbs cannot tell you which quest you're in until the read lands. The pair is one design: PARANOIA'S TWO TRUTHS.
Q135.P4.title: THE VALIDATED PARANOIAC [W3, with Q130]

Q135.P5.body: Bohemia's god-scale quests enter through the people the power left behind — and (F5's fix) the hook-NPC gets the closure node: Dervenin's Bohemian descendant is THERE at the end, and what the returned power says to them is the quest's last line.
Q135.P5.title: THE ABANDONED DEVOTEE HOOK [W7, F5 fixed]

Q135.P6.body: Bohemia's therapy-quests state their ceiling in one line at departure — repair as function restored, not person restored — and the Fold logs the distinction. The medicine currency's whole philosophy in one recurring closing beat.
Q135.P6.title: STABILIZED, NOT HEALED, SAID [W10, F7 fixed]

Q135.W1.body: Three rooms, three faculties, three failure modes of one documented mind — mental illness itemized into playable, READABLE spaces. Nothing else in the medium stages psychology this literally and this respectfully-under-the-jokes.
Q135.W1.title: THE DUNGEON IS A DIAGNOSIS

Q135.W10.body: The mind is left quieter, not whole — and alone again, the god departing being the quest's own success condition. The bittersweet is structural: you were hired to end the only visit.
Q135.W10.title: STABILIZED, NOT HEALED

Q135.W2.body: The cane's targets are symptoms and abstractions; every swing is an interpretive claim. Violence's grammar redirected into care without changing a single input.
Q135.W2.title: COMBAT VERBS REPURPOSED AS TREATMENT

Q135.W3.body: The threats WERE real — in the stands, mislocated. The quest's most humane read: the symptom wasn't delusion, it was mis-aimed accuracy. Strike the audience.
Q135.W3.title: THE PARANOIA ROOM VALIDATES THE PARANOIAC

Q135.W4.body: Aim at tiny Pelagius and everything worsens — the design encodes therapy's first law as a targeting rule.
Q135.W4.title: THE PATIENT IS NEVER THE TARGET

Q135.W5.body: Nightmares transform under treatment; the answer is staying with the changing thing through its changes. Iteration as care, mechanized.
Q135.W5.title: PERSISTENCE IS THE TERROR ROOM'S SOLVE

Q135.W6.body: The god who cannot say a sincere sentence is, structurally, the only being who visits the abandoned mad — the warmest fact in the file, never stated, always staged. Register as plausible deniability for grace.
Q135.W6.title: THE KINDNESS IS SMUGGLED IN COSTUME

Q135.W7.body: Entry through Dervenin's grief — madness's cost measured first in the people it leaves on the street holding a hip bone.
Q135.W7.title: THE HOOK IS THE ABANDONED DEVOTEE

Q135.W8.body: A sealed palace wing: the capital's own filing-away of its emperor is the door you pick. The court hid him in death as in life; the quest's first lockpick is against a society's memory.
Q135.W8.title: THE THRESHOLD IS INSTITUTIONAL AMNESIA

Q135.W9.body: The third single-door Daedric of the batch, and this one's narrowness reads as therapy's honest shape: no branches, just rooms revisited until they hold.
Q135.W9.title: FORKLESSNESS MEANS ITERATION HERE

Q135.X1.body: The register never once cracks to let Pelagius's reality land straight; players who don't do the second read get a romp through a real man's documented-in-lore torment. The camouflage (W-grade) is also a firewall (flaw-grade) — banked as the SAME choice, both-graded.
Q135.X1.title: THE COMEDY CEILING CAPS THE GRIEF

Q135.X10.body: The Wabbajack — a party toy — is the payment for the game's most conceptually serious dungeon; the item and the experience file in opposite drawers.
Q135.X10.title: THE REWARD-QUEST MISMATCH

Q135.X2.body: Each metaphor has exactly one read and one lever; the paranoia room especially resolves in seconds once understood. Diagnosis-as-puzzle deserved iteration depth (the terrors room has it; the others don't).
Q135.X2.title: THE ROOMS SOLVE ONCE AND SHALLOW

Q135.X3.body: The patient never speaks — not as ghost-butler (that's a phantom), not in the rooms, not at departure. The mind is toured; the man is absent from his own therapy. Deliberate (madness as the erasure of the self) or omission — banked both, F1's twin.
Q135.X3.title: PELAGIUS HAS NO VOICE ANYWHERE

Q135.X4.body: Chaos incarnate behaves deterministically all quest, then returns to randomness forever after; the item's one honest day goes unremarked.
Q135.X4.title: THE WABBAJACK'S PRECISION USE IS NEVER RECONCILED WITH ITS NATURE

Q135.X5.body: The hook's grief — a priest abandoned by his god — gets no closure node; master retrieved, beggar forgotten by the quest that ran on his plea.
Q135.X5.title: DERVENIN IS DROPPED

Q135.X6.body: The sealed wing — a capital's institutional forgetting of its mad emperor — is a doorway, not a theme; the political layer (courts hide their mad) is set dressing.
Q135.X6.title: SOLITUDE'S AMNESIA IS UNEXPLORED

Q135.X7.body: The honest ceiling (you repaired function, not the man) lives in inference; one departing line would have claimed it.
Q135.X7.title: STABILIZED-NOT-HEALED IS SUBTEXT ONLY

Q135.X8.body: The Princes' politics (Sheogorath among mortals' minds) touches nothing (F8's twin in Q134 — the pantheon never talks to itself).
Q135.X8.title: NO OTHER DAEDRA REGISTER THE HOUSE CALL

Q135.X9.body: The engine's only mindscape hosts comedy; the machinery (Q124's descent, Q127's painted world sought this) never gets its grief-register outing in this game.
Q135.X9.title: THE MIND-AS-SPACE TECH IS SPENT ON ONE JOKE-REGISTER INSTANCE

Q136.N1.body: the chamber, entry: charges laid Not one node — a LATTICE: each accusation is an option whose weight is a pre-existing flag: > "Ask Bann Sighard how his son came home." [gate: flag:saved_oswyn] -> a vote, aloud, with a reason attached > "The alienage. Tell them what you sold." [gate: has:slaver_docs] -> the room's loudest turn — evidence as detonation > "Anora will speak." [gate: flag:anora_deal] -> the queen testifies AGAINST her father — or, if the deal was fumbled, FOR him: the same node, inverted by prior handling. THE SWING NODE: one NPC, two testimonies, keyed to weeks-old choices (Q125-W7's text-changing climax, at parliamentary scale). > (eloquence alone) [gate: none] -> partial; the unfunded argument sways SOME — the quest is honest that rhetoric has a floor and a ceiling. NOVERB: "This chamber has no right to try a war." — THE JURISDICTION CHALLENGE DOESN'T EXIST. Loghain's actual best argument (an emergency regent answers to the war, not the peerage) is given to HIM in fragments and denied to the room as a formal motion; the procedure's legitimacy is the one thing the proc
Q136.N1.title: NODE THE_ROLL_CALL

Q136.N2.body: verdict in hand, entry: Loghain kneeling > "He dies today." [gate: none] -> the execution; Alistair's arc holds > "The Wardens need him. Conscription." [gate: none] THE DETONATOR -> Riordan's rite; ALISTAIR LEAVES — permanently, furiously, mid-scene; no charm, no history, no approval total un-writes it. THE CORPUS'S MOST EXPENSIVE DIALOGUE OPTION: one line, one companion, no undo. The red line that is ACTUALLY red — the anti-F3 (Q126's unanimous chorus was toothless; this dissent has teeth, walks, and takes his sword arm with him). NOVERB: "Alistair — I need you to accept this." — THE PERSUASION OF THE FRIEND IS NOT OFFERED. His line cannot be moved by any means the game contains; some people's limits are not content. 2nd confirmation of the UNPERSUADABLE-BY-DESIGN class (Q1's Tamara).
Q136.N2.title: NODE THE_CONSCRIPTION

Q136.P2.body: the Fold / mayor persistence / the three arcs Bohemia's act-finales are Landsmeets: assemblies (tribunal, council, the 13 factions' summit) whose votes render the Fold's accumulated state ALOUD — each faction's voice citing the actual entry that bought it ("the water ledger, month four — we remember"). F1's fix is native: the Fold IS the ledger view; the dynast can read their standing before walking in, and the drama relocates from surprise to CONFIRMATION. [PENDING, Paolo's call.]
Q136.P2.title: System

Q136.P3.body: One companion per generation carries an un-charmable limit that a single dynast decision detonates — permanently, mid-scene, no undo, no persuasion node. The .bq marks it @REDLINE and the validator confirms no gate can reach around it. The anti-laugh-track (Q126-F3's fix), built as architecture.
Q136.P3.title: THE RED LINE WITH TEETH [W5/W6]

Q136.P4.body: Bohemia's assemblies include abstentions, absences, and bought silence — and ONE named abstainer per vote whose refusal is itself a position the Fold records. The Q121 abstention-law, scaled to parliament.
Q136.P4.title: THE ABSTAINER IN THE ROLL CALL [F10 fixed, with Q121]

Q136.P5.body: If a Bohemia political resolution has a physical fallback (duel, siege, dial-combat), the fallback's PRICE matches the political route's — paid in different currency (Q132's four-currency law applied to resolution paths). The sword is never the cheap door.
Q136.P5.title: THE FALLBACK THAT COSTS THE SAME [F3 fixed]

Q136.P6.body: Bohemia's talk-past nodes run on the TARGET's surfaced doubt, gated [gate: knows:their_misgiving] — learned by listening earlier, never by charm. Cauthrien's mechanism as the standard model for every guard, gate, and loyal instrument in the game. Cross-ref Q106 (deserved information) and Q130 (client epistemology): the persuasion trilogy is complete — deserve it, write it, or midwife it. There is no fourth way and Bohemia ships none.
Q136.P6.title: PERSUASION AS MIDWIFERY [W7]

Q136.W1.body: The civil war resolves as parliamentary procedure with an audible count — the medium's fullest staging of politics AS the climax rather than before it.
Q136.W1.title: THE BOSS FIGHT IS A ROLL-CALL VOTE

Q136.W10.body: The roll call's audibility — each name, each reason — converts abstract standing into theater: the player HEARS their weeks of choices, one voice at a time. Feedback as ceremony.
Q136.W10.title: THE ROOM COUNTS ALOUD

Q136.W2.body: Side quests as silent constituencies: the session renders prior state. Q102's phonebook-law at institutional scale — the finale is a ledger-read.
Q136.W2.title: THE BALLOT WAS CAST WEEKS AGO

Q136.W3.body: Anora's node inverts on weeks-old handling — one queen, two testimonies, the swing vote as reactivity's crown jewel.
Q136.W3.title: THE SAME WITNESS TESTIFIES BOTH WAYS

Q136.W4.body: Loghain's rebuttals are real arguments with real merit; the debate is a debate, not a sentencing hearing with extra steps.
Q136.W4.title: THE ANTAGONIST ARGUES BACK, WELL

Q136.W5.body: Conscription costs Alistair — instantly, permanently, un-charmably. The corpus's most expensive line of dialogue, and the game never flinches from collecting.
Q136.W5.title: THE RED LINE HAS TEETH

Q136.W6.body: No build moves Alistair's limit — some people's boundaries are not content, and the design honors it by omission of the node.
Q136.W6.title: THE UNPERSUADABLE EXISTS

Q136.W7.body: Cauthrien turned aside not by your charm but by her conscience, surfaced — persuasion as midwifery, the quest's best minor mechanism.
Q136.W7.title: THE DOOR CAN BE TALKED PAST WITH HER OWN DOUBT

Q136.W8.body: Loghain fights his own trial-by-combat, always — the author-cannot-delegate law, honored by the OPPOSITION: his one non-negotiable dignity, and it characterizes him more than any speech.
Q136.W8.title: THE FALLBACK IS A DUEL THE ANTAGONIST WON'T DELEGATE

Q136.W9.body: Anora survives every branch by negotiation alone — the quest's true final boss is leverage in a dress, and she usually wins something.
Q136.W9.title: THE OPERATOR NEVER DRAWS A WEAPON

Q136.X1.body: No mechanism previews your standing; players discover their ballot in the room. Thrilling once, opaque always — LAW: political capital needs a LEDGER VIEW (the Fold would simply show it; DA:O had no organ).
Q136.X1.title: THE PRE-COUNT IS INVISIBLE UNTIL IT ISN'T

Q136.X10.body: Every bann votes; the roll call has no cowards, no absentees, no bought silence — the parliament is cleaner than any parliament. The missing abstention is the missing realism (and the missing Q121-abstainer).
Q136.X10.title: NO ABSTENTIONS EXIST

Q136.X2.body: A charm-specced Warden with zero homework still scrapes by too often; the roll-call's arithmetic bends to the protagonist more than the fiction admits.
Q136.X2.title: ELOQUENCE'S FLOOR IS TOO HIGH

Q136.X3.body: Losing the VOTE converting to winnable COMBAT lets martial builds skip the entire political layer — the sword as universal solvent dissolves the quest's own thesis. LAW: the fallback resolution must cost what the primary would have paid (the duel is nearly free).
Q136.X3.title: THE DUEL RESET

Q136.X4.body: The queen flips on dialogue minutiae in the eve-scene; the operator's logic is real but its tripwires are quiz-shaped.
Q136.X4.title: ANORA'S BETRAYAL TRIGGERS ARE TRIVIA

Q136.X5.body: Constituencies built in rich side quests compress to one shouted line each; the electorate's interiority is spent before the session that needed it.
Q136.X5.title: THE BANNS ARE VOTES, NOT PEOPLE, IN THE ROOM

Q136.X6.body: The option that costs Alistair is barely advocated (Riordan's one scene); the quest prices the choice magnificently and briefs it poorly.
Q136.X6.title: CONSCRIPTION'S STRATEGIC CASE IS UNDERARGUED

Q136.X7.body: His Orlais case is genuinely strong and no branch exists to partially credit it; the room can only convict or crown, never LEARN.
Q136.X7.title: LOGHAIN'S REBUTTALS OUTCLASS THE VERDICT SPACE

Q136.X8.body: The best minor node (loyalty talked past by its own doubt) sits at a door most players fight through on momentum.
Q136.X8.title: CAUTHRIEN IS FORGETTABLE BY PLACEMENT

Q136.X9.body: The crown's disposition — the war's actual stakes — resolves in the verdict's shadow with the room's drama already spent.
Q136.X9.title: THE THRONE SETTLEMENT OUTWEIGHS THE TRIAL AND ARRIVES EXHAUSTED

Q137.N1.body: the briefing, entry: through the relay The finale's dialogue is PERSONNEL DECISIONS; each is a node whose options are your roster: > "Tali/Legion/Kasumi takes the vent." [gate: role:tech + flag:loyal] -> lives, succeeds > "Garrus/Miranda/Jacob leads team two." [gate: role:leader + flag:loyal] -> their column survives > (assign by affection) [gate: none] TRAP-OF-LOVE -> the friend dies AT THE JOB — the finale's thesis in one casket: sentiment is not a qualification. Cross-ref Q101 (payload with opinions) inverted: here the escort quest's cargo is competence itself. NOVERB: "Nobody takes the vent. We find another way." — THE THIRD OPTION IS NOT OFFERED. The mission's shape is fixed; only the CASTING is yours. The finale removes the improviser's fantasy and leaves the manager's reality: you cannot re-plan, only staff. Bank: THE MANAGER'S FINALE — the corpus's only climax whose verbs are entirely HR.
Q137.N1.title: NODE THE_ASSIGNMENTS

Q137.N2.body: the crew rescued mid-raid, entry: they can't walk out alone > "Mordin/whoever — take them home." [gate: none] -> the escort LIVES BY LEAVING: the only guaranteed-survival assignment is the one that exits the story. Removal as safety, safety as removal — the option that saves a life by spending a presence. > "We can't spare anyone." [gate: none] SILENCE-AS-SENTENCE -> the crew dies off-screen; Chakwas's voice on the ramp is the receipt.
Q137.N2.title: NODE THE_ESCORT

Q137.N3.body: the base, entry: Reaper down > "Burn it." [gate: none] -> the Illusive Man's fury; the clean hands > "Keep it." [gate: none] -> the pragmatist's tithe; ME3's ledger takes the entry. (The corpus's third longest fuse: Q125, Q121, and this — one studio owns the mechanic.)
Q137.N3.title: NODE THE_KEEP_OR_BURN

Q137.P2.body: the Fold / succession / death-math Each Bohemia generation ENDS in a Suicide-Mission-class event: a crisis whose casualty list compiles from the generation's two ledgers — INFRASTRUCTURE (what the settlement built: the three currencies' standing stock) and BONDS (who the dynast actually knew: bond-state per companion/faction). No authored deaths; pure f(ledgers) -> who survives into the next generation. The succession system gains its actuarial engine. [PENDING, Paolo's call — this is the roguelite's spine candidate.]
Q137.P2.title: System

Q137.P3.body: Every audit-death in Bohemia names its cause IN-WORLD, at the moment: the Fold entry writes itself on-screen ("hull: un-reinforced. month 2's vote."). The receipt is the funeral rite. F1's fix is constitutional: the rules readable BEFORE (dossiers cite specialties at every assignment node — [gate: role:] displayed, not hidden).
Q137.P3.title: RECEIPTS DIEGETIC [W1, F1 fixed]

Q137.P4.body: Bohemia's bond-state is a GRADIENT, not a flag — half-helped is half-armor; reconciled-after-rupture carries a scar modifier. The .bq's bond gates take thresholds ([gate: bond:tali>=60]), and the finale's math reads the real number. The human middle states, held.
Q137.P4.title: PARTIAL CREDIT [F2/F9 fixed]

Q137.P5.body: Every Bohemia crisis-event includes one REMOVAL-AS-SAFETY assignment: a companion who survives certainly by exiting the event (escorting evacuees, holding the far gate). Spending presence to purchase a life — the choice's cost is the empty slot beside you for the rest of the fight.
Q137.P5.title: THE ESCORT CLAUSE [W5]

Q137.P6.body: The all-live run's paradox, solved by the Fold: a flawless generational audit writes its OWN entry — the crisis report that lists every death that DIDN'T happen and why ("vent: T. — lived. loyal, qualified, chosen right"). Bohemia makes the invisible masterpiece readable: the dodged bullet gets a receipt too. Gen 3 inherits the list of un-deaths. Nothing in the corpus does this; Bohemia can.
Q137.P6.title: PERFECT AUDITS MADE VISIBLE [F10 fixed]

Q137.W1.body: No dice, no spikes: each casualty names its cause in player-history — the un-bought plating, the un-heard companion, the wrong name at the vent. Consequence with a paper trail, at scale.
Q137.W1.title: EVERY DEATH IS A RECEIPT

Q137.W10.body: The Collectors are furniture; the antagonist is your own game-long ledger, walking beside you through the base. The finale externalizes nothing — every threat was always you.
Q137.W10.title: THE OPPONENT IS THE AUDIT

Q137.W2.body: Combat skill barely moves the count; listening and logistics move everything. The climax of a shooter is won in conversations and shopping — the medium's quietest genre betrayal, and its best.
Q137.W2.title: THE FINALE GRADES ATTENTION, NOT AIM

Q137.W3.body: The wound-closing missions convert to survival odds: being KNOWN by your commander is ballistic protection. The mechanic states the file's thesis without a line of dialogue.
Q137.W3.title: LOYALTY IS ARMOR, LITERALLY

Q137.W4.body: The mission's shape is fixed; the player's authorship is entirely WHO — the manager's finale, where every option list is a roster and every mistake is a staffing decision with a face.
Q137.W4.title: THE CASTING IS THE CHOICE

Q137.W5.body: The one guaranteed survival is the assignment that exits the story — presence spent to purchase absence. The design's subtlest line-item.
Q137.W5.title: THE ESCORT LIVES BY LEAVING

Q137.W6.body: The abduction timer converts the pre-mission lull into the first casualty table — readiness includes PUNCTUALITY, and the game means it.
Q137.W6.title: THE CLOCK STARTS BEFORE THE FINALE

Q137.W7.body: Shepard can die of insufficient bookkeeping — the audit exempts no one, including the camera's owner. The medium's only finale with a protagonist-solvency clause.
Q137.W7.title: THE HERO IS SUBJECT TO THE MATH

Q137.W8.body: The casualty list imports; ME3 is populated by your arithmetic's survivors and haunted by its receipts. The corpus's longest consequence tail (with Q125/Q121 — one studio, one law).
Q137.W8.title: THE DEAD STAY DEAD ACROSS A SEQUEL

Q137.W9.body: Fifteen through the relay and fifteen up the ramp — attainable, calculable, no luck involved. Hope as a spreadsheet you can actually balance; the counter-file to every doomed finale in the corpus.
Q137.W9.title: THE ALL-LIVE RUN EXISTS AND IS EARNED

Q137.X1.body: The assignment logic (who counts as "tech," what loyalty covers) is unstated; blind players lose loved companions to hidden rubrics and learn the rules from the internet, after. LAW: the audit's CATEGORIES must be diegetic (dossiers state specialties; the game had the documents and didn't cite them at the node).
Q137.X1.title: THE RULES ARE INVISIBLE AND THE WIKI IS MANDATORY

Q137.X10.body: The optimal path erases the finale's entire death-machinery; the masterpiece state is the one where the masterpiece never fires. Banked as the preparation-design paradox: PERFECT AUDITS ARE INVISIBLE.
Q137.X10.title: THE ALL-LIVE RUN IS THE CANON OF RECORD AND THE DESIGN'S QUIET DEFEAT

Q137.X2.body: One argument mis-handled weeks ago flips a flag that no later devotion can reset; relationships as fuses, not accounts. The model's cleanliness is its falseness.
Q137.X2.title: LOYALTY IS BINARY AND FOREVER

Q137.X3.body: Rewarding thoroughness for 40 hours then executing hostages for it is honest ONCE and vicious always; the reversal deserved one in-world warning (Joker knows; Joker could have said).
Q137.X3.title: THE HIDDEN CREW TIMER PUNISHES THE GAME'S OWN TAUGHT BEHAVIOR

Q137.X4.body: The trap-of-love is the thesis AND, absent F1's fix, indistinguishable from trivia failure. The same beat is profound or cheap depending entirely on information design.
Q137.X4.title: AFFECTION-ASSIGNMENT DEATHS CAN FEEL LIKE GOTCHAS

Q137.X5.body: Casualties resolve as brief holo-plaques; the funeral budget is one scene for up to a dozen dead. The arithmetic's gravity outruns its ceremony.
Q137.X5.title: SOME DEATHS ARE UNDER-WEIGHTED ON ARRIVAL

Q137.X6.body: The Collectors never adapt to your roster or exploit your gaps; the opponent is inert while the audit does everything. Thematically pure, dramatically thin.
Q137.X6.title: THE ENEMY IS SET DRESSING

Q137.X7.body: The hero dies only at near-total-loss thresholds most players never approach; the boldest rule in the design fires for almost no one.
Q137.X7.title: SHEPARD'S OWN DEATH CLAUSE IS TRIVIA-SHAPED

Q137.X8.body: The ship-ledger's currency comes from the game's worst minigame; the finale's steel half is bought with tedium, and the tedium leaks backward into the meaning.
Q137.X8.title: MINING FUNDED IT

Q137.X9.body: Un-loyal but present, half-helped, argued-with-then-reconciled — all compile to the same 0. The human middle states the model can't hold are where most real relationships live.
Q137.X9.title: THE SECOND LEDGER HAS NO PARTIAL CREDIT

Q138.N1.body: entry: the music box plays, the child answers > "What's in the closet?" [gate: none] -> P_NOTHING — the lie, complete, eye-level, rehearsed. The eight-year-old holds the door against the hero. > "I can help him." [gate: none] -> P_EJECT — the offer of help CONFIRMS the secret and hardens the guard: naming the father is the one mistake, and kindness makes it. THE FINDING: HELP DECLARED IS HELP DENIED — the guardian's lock cannot be opened by announcing the key (cf. Q133's warning-verb drift, inverted: here the warning verb exists and DETONATES). > (say nothing; leave; let the box play) [gate: none] SILENCE-AS-STRATEGY -> she relaxes toward the perimeter; the path opens. The quest's persuasion is PATIENCE plus INFRASTRUCTURE: you never win the argument; you make the house safe enough that the guard takes a walk. NOVERB: "Your father is dangerous." — THE TRUTH-AS-WARNING IS NOT OFFERED. No node exists to make the child fear her parent; the game will not put that sentence in anyone's mouth. The removed verb protects HER even from the player's honesty — cross-ref Q118 (the ceiling of the
Q138.N1.title: NODE PAMELA_DOOR

Q138.N2.body: entry: past the guard Not dialogue — the encounter grammar IS the node: > (draw a weapon) [gate: none] TRAP-OF-GENRE -> the staging invites it; the act is unforgivable-adjacent and the quest simply fails toward violence (the father can be "fought" — the game permits the misread and prices it in the only currency it has: the reunion never happens). Q135's targeting law at its rawest: THE PATIENT IS NEVER THE TARGET. > (play the Song of Healing) [gate: knows:the_song] -> the undoing; the wrappings fall; the mask remains. Comprehension as the correct verb — 11th confirmation, and the gentlest: the read here is WHICH TOOL, and the tool is a lullaby.
Q138.N2.title: NODE THE_CLOSET

Q138.P2.body: dialogue spec / bond-state / conscience One Bohemia quest per act gated by a PROTECTOR'S VIGILANCE — a person (child, spouse, devotee) hiding someone from help, where declaring the rescue hardens the lock and the solve is safety-built-first (infrastructure or trust raised until the guard can afford to look away). The .bq models the guard's attention as a stat the player lowers only by improving the guarded one's situation. HELP DECLARED IS HELP DENIED goes in the dialogue laws. [PENDING, Paolo's call.]
Q138.P2.title: System

Q138.P3.body: Bohemia's flagship emotional quests sit at the end of AUDITED infrastructure chains: the reunion gated on the water gated on the power gated on the perimeter — every link a real settlement system the city-builder already simulates. The corpus's proof that the genre-bridge works; Bohemia's proof should be Act 1's centerpiece family. Cross-ref Q132 PORT 5 (mercy's late fee): the chain's links cost real clock.
Q138.P3.title: SEVEN SYSTEMS, ONE HUG [W3]

Q138.P4.body: Locked with Q118's ceiling law: Bohemia's dialogue spec supports NOVERB-FOR-LISTENER — lines the player is denied not because the speaker can't say them but because the HEARER shouldn't hear them from you. The Fold may know the father is dangerous; no node lets the dynast teach a child to fear her parent. Writing law, compile-bound.
Q138.P4.title: VERBS REMOVED FOR THE HEARER'S SAKE [the NOVERB]

Q138.P5.body: Bohemia permits the violent misread of every heal-able encounter (no damage before the dial — and no scolding after), and prices it diegetically: ONE node, after, in the guardian's voice. Pamela's Bohemian descendant gets the line the original withheld. The silence was absence; ours will be judgment, once, quietly.
Q138.P5.title: THE MISREAD PRICED IN TEXT [W5, F7 fixed]

Q138.P6.body: When a Bohemia healing leaves equipment (and it should — the wrappings-as-mask image is too good to leave), the item carries its receipt per Q131 PORT 4: the [READ] names whose condition it was; the healed one reacts if they see it worn. The corpus's two mask-laws (Q128's testifying relic, Q131's receipt-bearing armor) close here as one.
Q138.P6.title: THE RECEIPT-MASK [W8, F3 fixed]

Q138.W1.body: The gate isn't a door or a stat — it's Pamela's vigilance, and the quest is unsolvable until you respect that the guarding IS love and route around it without breaking it.
Q138.W1.title: THE LOCK IS A CHILD'S PROTECTIVE LIE

Q138.W10.body: No argument defeats Pamela; patience and infrastructure do. The quest's persuasion model — make things safe enough that the guard can afford to look away — is the tenderest mechanic in the corpus.
Q138.W10.title: SILENCE IS THE WINNING STRATEGY

Q138.W2.body: Announcing the rescue hardens the guard; the offer confirms the secret. The corpus's cleanest model of why aid gets refused at the door it's most needed behind.
Q138.W2.title: HELP DECLARED IS HELP DENIED

Q138.W3.body: Water to power to music to perimeter to patrol-gap to closet to song: the emotional payoff sits at the end of a pure infrastructure chain, and every link is diegetic. The city-builder-to-RPG bridge, whole, in 2000.
Q138.W3.title: THE RESCUE IS SEVEN SYSTEMS DEEP

Q138.W4.body: The music box — installed to protect the house — draws its guardian outside: the same object is shield and key, and the player weaponizes their own good deed gently.
Q138.W4.title: THE SAFETY YOU BUILT IS THE DISTRACTION YOU USE

Q138.W5.body: The staging invites the sword; the solution is the Song of Healing. The misread is permitted, priced, and never scolded — the game trusts the player to feel the difference.
Q138.W5.title: THE MONSTER ENCOUNTER'S CORRECT VERB IS A LULLABY

Q138.W6.body: The domestic horror inversion — childhood's monster-location occupied by the person meant to check it — is the quest's one image, and it carries everything.
Q138.W6.title: THE PARENT IS THE THING IN THE CLOSET

Q138.W7.body: She runs past you, to him; the player watches from the doorway. Q101's not-about-you law and Q128's dismissed-witness, fused at family scale.
Q138.W7.title: THE REUNION EXCLUDES THE RESCUER

Q138.W8.body: The condition, healed, leaves equipment — the father's almost-death made wearable. Morally unremarked (F3) and imagistically perfect: the quest hands you the shape of what love was guarding.
Q138.W8.title: THE WRAPPINGS BECOME A MASK

Q138.W9.body: The rewind re-breaks everything; the player banks a reunion the world cannot keep. The Couple's Mask paradox in a minor key — the sibling quests are one law: THE PLAYER IS THE ONLY VAULT.
Q138.W9.title: THE HEALING HOLDS FOR THREE DAYS

Q138.X1.body: Pamela's vigilance — the quest's soul — is a patrol-AI with exploitable geometry; speedruns barge past the entire theme. LAW: if the lock is a person's attention, the attention needs senses, not sightlines.
Q138.X1.title: THE GUARDIAN CAN BE CHEESED

Q138.X10.body: Ikana's late-game gating means most players never meet Pamela at all; the corpus's tenderest quest lives in its least-visited postcode. Placement as quiet erasure (cf. Q128 F1's guide-dependence — the sibling quests share the flaw family).
Q138.X10.title: THE QUEST IS GEOGRAPHICALLY BURIED

Q138.X2.body: Restored, he speaks briefly and generically; the researcher who died-almost for knowledge has no node about what he learned. The quest heals him and forgets to ask him anything.
Q138.X2.title: THE FATHER HAS NO POST-REUNION VOICE BUDGET

Q138.X3.body: The wrappings become the player's tool (commanding gibdos, no less) — wearing the father's condition as equipment, and no one, including the game, notices. The receipt-bearing-relic law (Q131 PORT 4) violated in the softest possible way.
Q138.X3.title: THE GIBDO MASK'S ORIGIN IS MORALLY UNREMARKED

Q138.X4.body: The river's curse resolves a composer-ghost's torment (Sharp and Flat — a whole sibling tragedy) as a means to the box's end; one family's rescue is powered by another's compressed epilogue.
Q138.X4.title: THE UTILITIES CHAIN'S OWN GRIEF IS SPENT OFFHAND

Q138.X5.body: Post-reunion she becomes a generic happy child; the eight-year-old who ran a siege denial operation for weeks has no decompression node. The guard is dismissed without debrief.
Q138.X5.title: PAMELA'S AFTERMATH IS UNWRITTEN

Q138.X6.body: Q128 teaches the rewind tax explicitly; this quest lets players discover the re-broken closet cold — the cruelty is inherited but never locally acknowledged.
Q138.X6.title: THE THREE-DAY CEILING IS UNSIGNALED HERE

Q138.X7.body: Attack the father and the quest just... doesn't complete; no scene prices the mistake, no Pamela-node registers the intrusion's violence. The worst thing a player can do here is met with silence that reads as absence, not judgment.
Q138.X7.title: THE MISREAD PATH (fighting him) IS UNDER-PRICED IN TEXT

Q138.X8.body: The siege-home — the design's stage — has no domestic texture: no father's research notes, no child's drawings, no lived-in ledger. The family exists in two character models and a closet.
Q138.X8.title: THE HOUSE'S INTERIOR IS ONE ROOM DEEP

Q138.X9.body: That the music box draws Pamela out is discoverable only by observation; fair, elegant, and the single most missed step in the game's most missed quest.
Q138.X9.title: DISTRACTION-AS-KEY GOES UNTAUGHT

Not the atrocity: the authorship-laundering afterward. Port it as a conversation that happens AFTER any player deed the dial recorded as ugly-but-chosen: a witness offers to sell the player the excuse. The fold records the deed either way. What this conversation writes

Q139.P1.title: PORT 1 — THE EXCUSE MERCHANT [W8, F2 — the core port]
