Q148.X1.body: The spare route's white lie has zero risk, zero later cost, and no possible discovery — the client can never learn, the city never reacts, Salma never resurfaces. Critics of the contract system note the sparing choice is thereby cheapened: mercy with a guaranteed alibi is barely a choice. LAW: white lies to clients must be DISCOVERABLE in principle — a small, real probability path by which the fiction surfaces (the spared thing seen again; the trophy convention questioned), so that sparing is priced in risk, not just in conscience. The fold makes this natural: what the player told the client and what happened are BOTH entries, and any later system may read the gap.
Q148.X1.studyTitle: DEADLY DELIGHTS (THE CONTRACT FORMULA) (The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt)
Q148.X1.title: THE TROPHY LAUNDERS TOO CLEAN

Q148.X2.body: Witcher-sense trails cannot be lost, misread clues cannot send the player to a wrong conclusion with consequences — the investigation phase is a corridor dressed as deduction (long-standing series criticism). Contrast #141, where wrong reasoning costs real time. LAW: contract investigations must be ABLE to conclude wrong: a false-positive resolution (wrong culprit, paid anyway) that the world records and can surface later. If the deduction cannot fail, it is a tour. (The organ's rule-of-three machinery, #141, gives Bohemia the verification frame the formula lacks.)
Q148.X2.studyTitle: DEADLY DELIGHTS (THE CONTRACT FORMULA) (The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt)
Q148.X2.title: THE FORMULA'S INVESTIGATIONS DON'T FAIL

Q148.X3.body: Across dozens of contracts the formula's monster-is-somebody twist becomes the expected shape; late-game contracts telegraph their sympathy beats, and the class's power dilutes with volume (a criticism the series' own writers acknowledged in retrospectives). LAW: the job system's moral forks must be a MINORITY of contracts, on an unpredictable schedule. Most jobs should be exactly what they say (the monster is just a monster, the pay is just pay) so that the somebody-contracts land as discoveries, not genre beats. Ration the twist; volume is the twist's predator.
Q148.X3.studyTitle: DEADLY DELIGHTS (THE CONTRACT FORMULA) (The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt)
Q148.X3.title: REPEATABLE FORMAT, DIMINISHING PERSONHOOD

Q149.P1.body: system: settlement systems / the 13 factions / survival accounting The citizen web, adopted whole for Bohemia's settlements: named citizens with schedules on the beat (F3's law — the patrol/routine machinery is already wired), relationship edges, wellness states aggregating to settlement health with tipping points, and PILLAR citizens whose fates move the aggregate hard. The dark twin (citizens as XP) does NOT port — Bohemia's player isn't a predator — but the PR
Q149.P1.title: PORT 1 — THE SETTLEMENT WEB [W1, W3, W4 — the core port]

Q149.P2.body: system: [READ] / the conduct book (#143) / faction mechanics Learning a citizen (testimony, records, their web) unlocks BOTH care-verbs and harm-verbs for that citizen — the same knowledge opening the door to help them, leverage them, or sell them out, with the interface honest about the symmetry. The conduct book logs which door the knowledge went through. Intimacy as escrowed power is the web's deepest truth and it ports without the vampire.
Q149.P2.title: PORT 2 — DUAL-USE INTIMACY [W2, W5]

Q149.P3.body: system: the dial / progression Hard rule for the dial's economy: no conscience-path may change combat viability class. Mercy prices in texture — options, standing, the fold's read, who answers your letters — never in the numbers the dial checks. Machine-checkable once progression tables exist: the validator diffs power curves across conscience-paths and rejects divergence beyond threshold.
Q149.P3.title: PORT 3 — CONSCIENCE IS NEVER THE DIFFICULTY SLIDER [F1's law — a balance gate]

Q149.P4.body: system: quest structure / testimony systems Bohemia keeps the false-mercy branch (sentiment-without-followthrough detonating) — the corpus's best-taught lesson — but the world testifies FIRST (#146 F3's telegraphing law): prior cases, witness accounts, a professional's warning, all available before the fork. Wrong remains possible; uninformed does not. The trap becomes a test of listening instead of an ambush.
Q149.P4.title: PORT 4 — THE INFORMED TRAP [W7 kept, F2 fixed]

Q149.P5.body: system: the fold / settlement health / hidden communities Every settlement-scale fork prices across at least two distinct ledgers, and at least one consequence flows to a community the player has barely met (the web past sight, billed anyway). Compile-countable: fork specs declare their ledgers; single-ledger forks get sent back. [PENDING, Paolo's call: Bohemia's hidden communities — the sewer-skal slot is pure canon.]
Q149.P5.title: PORT 5 — THREE-LEDGER BILLING [W8, W10]

Q149.W1.body: Named, scheduled, connected, and worth XP: the population is simultaneously the game's heart and its loot table, and the interface refuses to hide either fact. The most honest predation economy ever shipped.
Q149.W1.title: EVERY CITIZEN IS PRICED

Q149.W10.body: The sewer skals — a community most players barely meet — pay for the fork's failure modes. Consequences that flow to the barely-known make the city feel infinite in exactly the way a settlement sim needs.
Q149.W10.title: THE WEB EXTENDS PAST THE PLAYER'S SIGHT AND BILLS ANYWAY

Q149.W2.body: The hint system fuses intimacy with appetite — investigation raises blood quality — so every act of care builds capacity for harm. Dual-use knowledge as a core loop, not a theme statement.
Q149.W2.title: KNOWING PEOPLE MAKES THEM MORE NUTRITIOUS

Q149.W3.body: Aggregated wellness with tipping points turns neighborhoods into stakes without a single scripted consequence — the world's judgment is arithmetic the player can watch coming.
Q149.W3.title: THE DISTRICT IS A HEALTH BAR MADE OF PEOPLE

Q149.W4.body: Putting the fork on the district's pillar makes the moral choice and the systemic one the same choice. Structure and story fused at the exact point of maximum pressure.
Q149.W4.title: THE HARDEST CASE IS THE LOAD-BEARING CITIZEN

Q149.W5.body: The third option exists only if the player learned the man — the same hints that fatten his blood unlock his salvation. One ledger, two doors: the system's knowledge economy pays out in whichever direction the player's hands choose.
Q149.W5.title: REDEMPTION IS GATED ON INTIMACY

Q149.W6.body: Giving blood spends progression backward. Mercy priced in the predator's currency is conscience-no-karma-bar in its purest shipped form: no meter moves; the player is simply POORER and the saint is simply saved.
Q149.W6.title: THE CLEAN EXIT COSTS THE PLAYER'S OWN COIN

Q149.W7.body: Spare-as-is out-damages predation — the game's harshest authored opinion, delivered entirely through consequences: sentiment without treatment is abandonment. (Bank the fairness fix in F2; keep the opinion.)
Q149.W7.title: FALSE MERCY IS THE WORST BRANCH

Q149.W8.body: District, hidden community, player power — the fork's prices land on different accounts, so no single meter can summarize the choice. Judgment by distributed arithmetic beats any alignment system.
Q149.W8.title: CONSEQUENCES BILL THREE LEDGERS

Q149.W9.body: Health bars, locked shelters, a newspaper headline: the game replies in city, never in interface. The Q139 loading-screen judge's benign twin — the world as the read-back surface.
Q149.W9.title: THE VERDICT ARRIVES AS WORLD-STATE

Q149.X1.body: The XP gap between abstaining and feeding is so large that a no-feed run is a difficulty mode (underleveled for every boss), while a feeding run trivializes combat. Widely criticized: the moral economy becomes a DIFFICULTY SLIDER, and players choose their ethics by their appetite for boss fights. LAW: conscience must never be the difficulty setting. Price mercy in TEXTURE (options, relationships, world-state, the fold's read) — never in raw combat viability. If the merciful player is mechanically weaker, ethics collapses into masochism and predation into convenience; the dial's balance must hold at every conscience level.
Q149.X1.title: THE ECONOMY OVERPOWERS THE THEME FOR POWER-PLAYERS

Q149.X2.body: Spare-as-is reads as the good option and detonates into the worst outcome, with little in-scene warning that untreated hunger MUST win. Players report feeling tricked rather than taught — the lesson (intentions aren't verbs) lands, but by ambush, and the massacre is discovered late or never connected. LAW: the world must testify BEFORE the fork about what untreated conditions do (the sewer skals' own histories, a prior case, a doctor's warning) — the information available, the sentiment still tempting, the trap then FAIR. Bohemia's telegraphing law (#146 F3) extends to moral traps: the player may be wrong, never uninformed.
Q149.X2.title: THE SPARE TRAP PUNISHES WITHOUT TELEGRAPHING

Q149.X3.body: Citizens keep static routes and conversation loops; outside their quests they idle, and the "living district" reads as a diorama between story beats — the criticism that the web is a menu of meals wearing a neighborhood's face. LAW: the citizen web must run on the world's clock, not the quest log's. Bohemia's beat-driven sim and patrol machinery (7/17 wiring) already move people by law; settlement citizens need the same treatment — schedules, absences, and reactions that tick with the world so the web stays alive between adjudications. (The #146 five-property checklist, applied to friendly institutions.)
Q149.X3.title: THE WEB'S SCHEDULES ARE SHALLOW UNDER PRESSURE

Q150.W1.title: THE LIAR IS THE HIGHEST AUTHORITY IN THE ROOM

Q150.W10.title: THE GOD'S INTERVENTION IS THE TELL

Q150.W2.body: Vaermina's offer is genuine — unique artifact, truly missable. Lies wrapped around true payment are the only lies worth designing; the player's greed does the persuading, not the prose.
Q150.W2.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W2.title: THE BRIBE IS REAL AND ONLY THE ACCUSATION IS FALSE

Q150.W3.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W3.title: THE CONFESSION ARRIVES IN VOLUNTEERED INSTALLMENTS

Q150.W4.body: The only way past the barrier is through a participant's memory of the atrocity, performed from inside. Memory as a door; testimony as level design; the player converted from listener to witness by walking.
Q150.W4.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W4.title: THE DREAMSTRIDE: TRAVERSAL BY TESTIMONY

Q150.W5.body: No speech check, no stat, no flag — the fork reads nothing but the player's assessment of a man versus a god. The rarest gate in the genre: unassisted human judgment, with the interface refusing to help.
Q150.W5.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W5.title: THE FINALE'S GATE IS PURE JUDGMENT

Q150.W6.body: The whisper cannot be shared, tested, or subpoenaed; no verb exists to confront Erandur with it. The test's apparatus is loneliness — exactly how real manipulation prefers its targets.
Q150.W6.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W6.title: THE PRIVATE CHANNEL ISOLATES THE JUROR

Q150.W7.body: Veren and Thorek — what staying loyal to Vaermina looks like after a decade — are met and fought at the altar's threshold. Reform is proven against its alternative, on screen, in the same room.
Q150.W7.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W7.title: THE CONTROL GROUP IS ARMED AND WAKES UP

Q150.W8.body: Kill him and the betrayal claim is never tested; the killer keeps their rationalization forever. Information asymmetry as moral architecture: the wrong choice protects itself from being known as wrong.
Q150.W8.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W8.title: THE MURDER BRANCH BURIES ITS OWN EXONERATION

Q150.W9.body: Decline the artifact and gain a companion — the quest pays its faithful in relationship, its faithless in equipment, and lets the player discover which currency their game runs on.
Q150.W9.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.W9.title: THE REWARD FOR TRUST IS A PERSON

Q150.X1.body: The Oblivion Walker achievement counts daedric artifacts; the Skull is permanently missable; guides therefore instruct the murder as a matter of completion hygiene. For a large share of players the finale was never a trust test — it was a checklist item, and the god's lie won by default through the achievement system. LAW: out-of-fiction completion incentives must NEVER side with a moral fork's dark branch by construction. If Bohemia ships collection meta (records, banks, the graveyard's own registers), forks must be either meta-neutral (both branches feed the collection differently) or meta-silent (the fork's outputs live outside collection accounting). The dial's choices belong to the fiction; the checklist must recuse itself.
Q150.X1.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.X1.title: THE METAGAME ARGUES FOR THE DEVIL, TOO LOUDLY

Q150.X2.body: Dawnstar's nightmares end on BOTH branches — the town, the quest's entire motivating suffering, is fine either way. The fork's real stakes (a man's life, a god's weapon, the truth) are strong, but the design quietly removes the civic stakes at the exact moment of decision, and players who murdered report barely noticing a cost. LAW: never detach the fork from the suffering that motivated the quest. If the choice at the altar is real, the town's fate should ride some part of it — or the design should own, loudly, that the remaining stakes are persons and truths, and make THOSE consequences visible enough to carry the weight (the fold's read, the companion's absence, the organ's record).
Q150.X2.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.X2.title: THE STAKES FLATTEN AT THE FORK

Q150.X3.body: Decline the god, gain a follower — and the world never remarks on any of it. No priest of Mara notes the reformed man's vindication; no record exists that a god personally lied and lost. Skyrim's radial structure spends its best scene and banks nothing; the quest's meaning lives entirely in the player's head (which is why it's beloved by the few and skipped-to-the-Skull by the many). LAW: when a player passes a trust test a GOD set, the ledger writes it. The fold records divine-class deception survived; the read-back surfaces (#140/#143) can cite it; the companion's own dialogue should carry the debt. Bohemia's whole architecture exists so that scenes like this one compound instead of evaporating — the flaw is the strongest possible argument for the fold, banked from the game that lacked one.
Q150.X3.studyTitle: WAKING NIGHTMARE (THE GOD WHO LIES AT THE FINALE) (The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim)
Q150.X3.title: THE TRUST BRANCH GOES UNREAD

Q151.P5.title: PORT 5 — THE SETTLEMENT TESTIFIES [F3's law, W10]

The indifference that made #146's captivity honest makes the freehold's survival honest too — and hands Bohemia the same lesson twice: the LEDGER must witness what the world won't (#146 F1, confirmed at scale).

Q151.W2.body: The collector's visit is insult and milestone in one: the world's first acknowledgment that the player EXISTS arrives as a bill. No fanfare could land harder than an invoice.
Q151.W2.title: THE TAX IS THE RECOGNITION

Q151.W3.body: Success generates its own antagonists by arithmetic — the difficulty curve is the player's balance sheet, and modesty becomes a viable defensive strategy. Wealth as aggro is post-collapse truth, mechanized.
Q151.W3.title: RAIDS SCALE WITH VISIBLE PROSPERITY

Q151.W4.body: The game's real armor was always the ability to leave; the base trades it away voluntarily. The arc's dread flows from one honest exchange rate, never from a script.
Q151.W4.title: BUILDING IS THE SURRENDER OF MOBILITY

Q151.W5.body: Door policy broadcasts the settlement's ethics to everyone who approaches — reputation without a meter, values as architecture. (LIGHT=TERRITORY's sibling law, found in the wild.)

Q151.W6.body: The fight's arena is the player's own labor, so every breach costs biography. No authored setpiece can buy the stakes that hauling your own walls builds for free.
Q151.W6.title: THE SIEGE HAPPENS WHERE THE HOURS LIVE

Q151.W7.body: Abandoning everything mid-siege stays on the table, always — and its standing availability is what makes staying a CHOICE instead of a checkpoint. (The Q140 off-ramp law, at settlement scale.)
Q151.W7.title: THE FLEE OPTION NEVER CLOSES

Q151.W8.body: Lone survivor to squad to settlement in one unbroken system-set — no mode switch, no genre seam. The proof that the fold's arc (dynast → settlement → city) can be ONE game, not three bolted together.
Q151.W8.title: THE SCALE-SHIFT IS SEAMLESS

Q151.W9.body: Unwritten recruits become devastating losses purely through invested hours — the pool's investment law, and the siege's ammunition. Authored backstory is optional; leveled-by-hand is not.
Q151.W9.title: ATTACHMENT IS MANUFACTURED BY LABOR

Q151.X1.body: Raids path predictably, funnel into kill-boxes, and veteran bases become farms that harvest their own attackers — the world's terrifying bill matures into a turret-fed income stream. The pool banked the general seams; at outpost scale the seam is fatal: the arc's crown event becomes a routine the player designed once. LAW: siege-class threats must read the defense and vary the approach (composition, timing, target selection — burn the crops, not the kill-box), or cap their own frequency below routine-formation. A siege the player can schedule is a subscription, not a story. (Bohemia's beat-world and faction sim can vary by LAW: attackers who learned the last siege's shape — the #146 curriculum property, pointed back at the player.)
Q151.X1.title: THE SIEGE AI COLLAPSES INTO PATTERNS

Q151.X2.body: The collectors demand, the raiders raid — but there is no envoy TO them: no tribute renegotiation, no alliance offer, no buying a raid's redirection onto a rival. The settlement is addressable by everyone and can address no one; the world's politics remain read-only, and the arc's midgame thins into pay-or-fight. LAW: ownership must open VERBS, not just liabilities. The moment the settlement enters the world's books, the player gets the ledger's other side: envoys, terms, redirections, joint defenses — the faction graph is already typed for it. A settlement that can be billed but cannot negotiate is scenery with a health bar.
Q151.X2.title: THE POLITICS HAVE ONE VERB

Q151.X3.body: The recruits the siege spends have no reaction to any of it — no one resents the defied tax, mourns the burned forge, or credits the held wall. The attachment is real (the investment law) but entirely player-side; the settlement never speaks about itself, and post-siege mornings are emotionally load-bearing moments the game leaves mute. LAW: the settlement testifies. Bohemia's citizen web (#149) plus bark-scale reactions give the interior a voice: the fold logs the siege, the residents reference it, the gate's history is spoken of. One night of consequence should echo in the settlement's text for a generation — that echo is what Kenshi's silence proves is missing.
Q151.X3.title: THE INTERIOR LIFE IS SILENT

Q152.W1.body: Employer and enemy are one being, sequentially revealed — the highest form of the unreliable quest-giver: he isn't lying; he's DOOMED, and the briefing's omission is his survival strategy.

Q152.W1.title: THE QUEST-GIVER IS THE APOCALYPSE ON A TIMER

Q152.W10.body: After G-4, every earlier scene re-reads — the jokes, the errands, the interview. A quest that retroactively rewrites its own first half is doing with structure what twists usually fake with surprise.

Q152.W10.title: THE WHOLE SCRIPT REPLAYS ITSELF

Q152.W2.body: Every errand, in hindsight, was training for the seat: the fetch quests were rehearsals of rulership (someone pays, you pick who). The second-playthrough re-read is designed, not incidental.

Q152.W2.title: THE RECRUITMENT IS ONBOARDING

Q152.W9.body: The arc ends in an office, not a payout — succession as prize, with the timer attached. The genre's boldest ending shape, even underfunded (F1): what you win is what he was.
Q152.W9.studyTitle: THE GREYMARCH (INHERITING THE MAD GOD'S OFFICE) (The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion — The Shivering Isles)
Q152.W9.title: THE REWARD IS THE JOB

Q152.X1.body: After coronation, ruling amounts to a throne-room chair, a couple of petitioner novelties, and the chamberlain's shrug. The genre's boldest reward — BECOMING the god — ships with almost no verbs; the title is a hat. Community consensus for two decades: the ending writes a check the systems never cash. LAW: never grant an office without granting its VERBS. If Bohemia's fold ever seats a player in an institution (settlement head, faction chair, the throne-analog), the seat must come with the working ledger: petitions with stakes, policies with teeth (#151's gate policy is the scale model), succession paperwork of its own. An office without verbs is a cosmetic — cut it or staff it.
Q152.X1.studyTitle: THE GREYMARCH (INHERITING THE MAD GOD'S OFFICE) (The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion — The Shivering Isles)
Q152.X1.title: THE OFFICE IS A TROPHY, NOT A JOB

Q152.X2.body: Mania or Dementia colors the regalia and a handful of scenes, then the endgame funnels identically. The expansion's one exclusive moral fork — WHO the player murders for advancement — barely differentiates the world after; players compare notes and find mostly palette. LAW: an exclusive rite must write exclusive CONSEQUENCE — the court passed over should act like it (grudges, defections, a rival claimant), and the fold should read which throne was taken and how, at the finale (#140/#143's machinery exists for exactly this). If both branches converge, converge the STORY, never the ACCOUNTABILITY.
Q152.X2.studyTitle: THE GREYMARCH (INHERITING THE MAD GOD'S OFFICE) (The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion — The Shivering Isles)
Q152.X2.title: THE ACCESSION FORK IS WEIGHTLESS DOWNSTREAM

Q152.X3.body: The curse ends because the player wins a duel: no cost, no trade, no residue — the realm's thousand-era tragedy resolves as a boss health bar. Even sympathetic critics note the finale's metaphysics outweigh its mechanics: the deepest lore event in the setting is mechanically a Tuesday. LAW: breaking a cycle must cost cycle-denominated currency. Bohemia's generational frame prices this natively: ending a standing curse-class system (an Edict, #145; a faction's cyclical purge; the Greymarch-analog if one exists) should spend something only generations can bank — a lineage's accumulated record, a fold-held debt, an office's own continuity. Cheap exits from expensive cycles teach the player the cycle was never real. [PENDING, Paolo's call: what Bohemia's cycles even are — the law stands ready either way.]
Q152.X3.studyTitle: THE GREYMARCH (INHERITING THE MAD GOD'S OFFICE) (The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion — The Shivering Isles)
Q152.X3.title: THE CYCLE'S BREAKING IS FREE
